purpose: Record the first narrow GPU-only vendored oneDNN grouped-memory grouped-matmul smoke that builds, links, and executes on an Intel Arc Pro B70.
quality_scope: Build/API smoke only. No endpoint promotion, no speed claim, and no W8A8 route-exact quality claim yet.
runtime_note: The oneAPI compiler 2025.3 environment alone did not expose SYCL GPU platforms. Runtime execution required compiler 2025.3 lib plus UMF 1.1, TCM 1.5, and TBB 2023.0 library paths.
negative_findings: DNNL_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE=MATMUL with DNNL_CPU_RUNTIME=SEQ configured but still created a broad 921-step build because CPU matmul branches stayed in scope.
DNNL_CPU_RUNTIME=NONE narrowed the standalone dnnl target to roughly 560 steps and compiled the grouped Intel GPU objects.
MATMUL-only full dnnl target failed in gpu_sdpa_list.cpp because an SDPA dispatcher list was still compiled while SDPA was disabled.
The internal dnnl_gpu_intel target succeeded with MATMUL-only but did not produce a linkable libdnnl.a.
successful_path: Reconfigured the GPU-only build with DNNL_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE=MATMUL;SDPA.
Built the static dnnl target successfully.
Ran the example with ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:0 and it reported Example passed on GPU.

example_output_summary.token_distribution: 30 total tokens routed to 4 experts (12, 8, 0, 10 tokens per expert)

next_steps: Fork the oneDNN grouped matmul example into a Qwen3.6 routecapture6 layer-9 replay fixture.

Replace the f32 example tensors with the current route-exact W8A8 data path: s8 routed activations or oneDNN-supported source format, s8 expert weights, per-token activation scales, per-expert-column weight scales, and f32/bf16-equivalent output accumulation as required by the accepted path.
Measure primitive creation time separately from execution time; cache primitive descriptors by route signature if creation is nontrivial.
Compare the oneDNN grouped path against the current 112-114 us two-dispatch grouped-GEMM floor and the 168 us/layer non-speculative budget.
Only consider endpoint integration after max_abs_diff=0.0 against current xpu_fused_moe on captured real routes and accepted provenance sentinels.
